result.edit: The failure shows the output was 1 when expected to be 0 at cycle 4 with count=4 and mode=0. The current implementation uses (div>>1) for the output condition, which is too lenient (outputs 1 for counts up to div/2). Changing to (div>>2)+1 matches the specification's requirement of floor(div/4)+1. This will make the output 1 only for counts <= floor(div/4)+1, fixing the mismatch with the expected waveform.
